name: Iglucraft Panoramic Iglusauna 6-Person Fully Assembled Outdoor Sauna
description: Panoramic Iglusauna Fully Assembled, Outdoor Sauna, 6-person Like a double sauna, our panoramic sauna features a steaming room together with a relaxing room, but additionally offers a panoramic window for endless views and sauna conversations with friends or family. The steam room that comfortably accommodates 6 people boasts the traditional Iglusauna steaming experience and views of your surroundings, inviting in the beauty of the outdoors. It is a sauna experience no one will ever forget. Which would you like more, a wood-fired or an electrical stove? Experience personal wellness, reflection, and relaxation in the expertly crafted Iglusauna Panoramic sauna, meticulously built by Iglucraft artisans in Nordic Estonia and delivered fully assembled. Spacious enough to host gatherings, this sauna offers a unique home retreat distinguished by its captivating design and elegance. Comfortably accommodating up to six people, it provides a lasting space for your family and friends to enjoy enhanced well-being, comfort, and tranquility for years to come. NOTE: Unit is sold and shipped fully assembled. Iglucraft understands your passion for saunas and has crafted a high-quality 147 sq. ft. sauna suite designed for optimal bather comfort. Featuring a separate lounge area with ample space for relaxation, the sauna includes silky-smooth aspen benches that enhance comfort. Its natural curved design promotes efficient circulation of heat and steam for an unparalleled sauna experience. Additionally, a dedicated dressing room/lounge offers a comfortable space to unwind before or after your session. The sauna displays exceptional craftsmanship both inside and out. A wooden door featuring a large glass window allows natural light to brighten the interior while providing convenient entry. The striking black wooden floor contrasts elegantly with the light aspen benches, backrests, and footrests. This sturdy, expertly built sauna is delivered fully assembled to your home for immediate use. Prewired dotless LED lighting beautifully highlights the interior, enhancing the natural elegance of the carefully chosen wood. With unlimited brightness control, you can easily tailor the ambiance to suit your desired mood. The Iglucraft Panoramic sauna offers two distinct heating options. For a rustic, traditional experience, it includes a wood-fired sauna stove and chimney. Alternatively, for modern convenience, the unit can be equipped with an electric sauna heater and features an electrical compartment for easy installation (electric sauna heater sold separately). Experience a uniquely crafted sauna embodying enduring elegance and exceptional comfort—the Iglucraft Panoramic home sauna suite, created by skilled artisans.
